name: root-basic
description: Target-scoped CTF profile for simple Java boolean root-check methods after explicit authorization.
allowedUse: Only CTF, lab, self-owned apps, or explicitly authorized testing. Never global device patching.

actions.description: Example hook: RootBeer.isRooted() -> false when the class exists in target process.

revert.description: Detach the Frida session or call ctf.revert_bypass_profile.
